text: At its meeting held March 20 - 22, 2024, City Council reappointed the following members to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board for a term of office from March 22, 2024, to March 22, 2028, and until successors are appointed: - Graysanne Bedell; - Andrew Dooner; - Wayne Miranda; and - Parminder Sandhu.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund received the item for information.
